name: @arfa-tools/generator
author: Dmitry Kazakov
description: An automation core for frontend development workflows

scripts.npm-publish: bun run build && cd ./dist && bun publish --access public --tag latest && cd ../
scripts.updg: bun run clear-modules && bun install --filter ./ && bun install --global @arfa-tools/generator@latest
scripts.bench: bun units/api-contract-check/builder.bench.ts && bun units/generator/FileGenerator.bench.ts && bun run clear-tmp
scripts.test: bun test --coverage --reporter=junit --reporter-outfile=./test-results/junit.xml && bun scripts/saveTestMetrics.ts && bun run clear-tmp
scripts.full-check: bun run analyze && bun run check-types && bun run build && bun run test && bun run example:analyze
scripts.example:analyze: bun run --cwd examples/orders biome check --no-errors-on-unmatched --write . && bun check -p examples/orders
scripts.docs:preview: bun run docs:build && vitepress preview vitepress
